Name: Better Retaining Soils
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
Do you find the vanilla retaining soil mechanic somewhat underpowered? This mod improves its core functionality to make it significantly more valuable! Now, when you water a crop with a retaining soil, the fertilizer will keep the crop watered for multiple days.

You can customize the duration it retains moisture. By default:

[list]
[*]Basic Retaining Soil maintains moisture for [b]2 days[/b]
[*]Quality Retaining Soil maintains moisture for [b]5 days[/b]
[/list]
Notes that you should use the retaining soils before you watering the dirt, because your retaining soils needs water (wink~), otherwise you may need to water the dirt again to ensure it takes effect.

This mod frees you from the repetitive chore of daily watering, especially valuable in the early stage of the game! When combined with even a few basic sprinklers, it can water a large number of crops at minimal time cost. Discover more creative ways to use it!

This mod supports i18n, and contributions are welcome! You can commit your translation on [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/tree/master/BiggerContainers#translating-the-mods]Github[/url]. English is not my mother tongue, so for native English users, if you want to improve the current English translation, you can also come and help!

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

This mod includes compatibility patches for most major mods with overlapping functionality, such as:

[list]
[*]Visible soil moisture status via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url] (shows remaining days of moisture)
[*]Full integration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21318]Ultimate Fertilizer[/url]
[*] ...and other mods you might not expect!
[/list]
[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=4]Found a bug?[/size][/b]

Please submit bugs on the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿, please avoid leave comments at nexus because I don't check it often.

[b][size=4]Thanks to...[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] for [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
[/list]


你是否觉得原版游戏保湿土壤的机制有些鸡肋？这个模组改进了它的机制，让其变得更有价值！现在，当你给使用了保湿土壤的作物浇水时，它能够能让作物保持湿润状态长达数天！

你还可以自定义保湿土壤维持水分的天数。默认设置为：

[list]
[*]初级保湿土壤可保湿 [b]2 天[/b]
[*]高级级保湿土壤可保湿 [b]5 天[/b]
[/list]
注意：你需要先给田地使用施保湿土壤，然后再浇水（因为保湿土壤需要水分，确信）。如果你弄反了，则需要再浇水一次来让他生效。

这个模组能让你从每天重复浇水的繁琐工作中解放出来，在游戏前期尤其有用。若再配合少量的洒水器甚至可以以极低的时间成本浇灌完大片的土地，更多用法等待你的发掘！

[b][size=4]兼容性[/size][/b]

为大部分功能重叠的模组进行了兼容适配，例如：

[list]
[*]可以使用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url] 来查看水分还可维持多少天
[*]兼容 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21318]Ultimate Fertilizer[/url]
[*]以及其它你可能想不到的模组兼容
[/list]

[b][size=4]安装并使用此 Mod[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]请先安装[url=https://smapi.io]最新版本的 SMAPI[/url]﻿；
[*]将此 Mod 下载解压至 Mods 文件夹；
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏
[/list]
